## Professional Summary

Quantitative Data Scientist with over 8 years of experience bridging rigorous statistical methodology with production-grade software engineering. Specialized in Decision Optimization under Uncertainty, Bayesian Statistics, Causal Inference, and A/B Experimentation. Proven track record of architecting end-to-end analytical solutions—from linear programming and hierarchical Bayesian modeling to containerized, production-ready web applications (PyShiny) and scalable GCP data pipelines. Adept at transforming ambiguous business problems into scientifically grounded algorithms that drive measurable margin and operational improvements.

---

## Key Competencies & Tech Stack

- **Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling:** Gradient Boosting (XGBoost, CatBoost), Scikit-Learn, Hierarchical Bayesian Modeling, Customer/Partner Segmentation, Model Explainability (SHAP).
- **Experimentation & Causal Inference:** Online A/B Testing Strategy, Experimental Design, Synthetic Controls, Causal Impact Evaluation.
- **Programming & Data Engineering:** Advanced SQL (BigQuery, PostgreSQL), Python (Polars, Pandas, PyMC, Pyomo, Scikit-learn, PyShiny), R, PySpark.
- **Cloud, Infrastructure & MLOps:** GCP (BigQuery, Airflow), Docker, CI/CD, Git, AWS, Snowflake.
